usage: Members should have 2FA enabled to access source control
name: Members should have 2FA enabled to access source control
description: 2FA is generally considered more secure than using just IDP or a username and password. Enable 2FA to harden the access to your repositories
detailedDescription: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) helps reduce the probability that a user's account will be compromised. Admins in particular should have 2FA enabled as a compromise can be devastating. Therefore, in order to reduce the attack surface, it is recommended to have 2FA enabled.
